summary.title: In short
summary.note: This summary is for orientation only. The full privacy policy below is the binding text.
points: We are The Switzerland Chapter of ICF, an association in Arbon. You can reach us at office@coachingfederation.ch.
We only collect what we need: for example your name and email when you contact us, register for an event, subscribe to the newsletter, or have a member account.
We use your data to answer you, run events, send newsletters you asked for, and show coach profiles that members chose to publish.
Trusted service providers help us, such as our website platform, our email service, and Stripe for payments. Some are in the USA and are bound by data protection contracts.
Member data comes from ICF Global, our parent organisation, once a night.
We keep data only as long as needed, then delete it. Payment records are kept for 10 years because Swiss law requires it.
We use no analytics or tracking. The only cookie is a short-lived security cookie that tells real visitors from bots.
You can ask to see, correct, or delete your data at any time. Just write to us.
